workflows.scenario: Launch the bank simulator and enter the dashboard

steps.action: Click the GET STARTED NOW button on the landing page
steps.expected: The browser navigates to /bank-sim/ and a welcome dialog appears with the heading 'Welcome to the NGPF Bank Simulator'

steps.action: Click Ok on the welcome dialog to dismiss it
steps.expected: The welcome dialog closes and the dashboard is fully visible showing checking account balance of $216.04, savings account balance of $230.00, and upcoming bills

workflows.test: generated_tests/www.ngpf.org/playwright_tests/tests/home.spec.ts#launch the bank simulator and enter the dashboard

workflows.scenario: View checking and savings account transaction history
preconditions: An active simulator session exists (GET STARTED NOW has been clicked and the welcome dialog dismissed)
The simulator dashboard is displayed at /bank-sim/

steps.action: Open the ACCOUNTS nav menu and click ACCOUNT ACTIVITY
steps.expected: The Account Activity page loads at /bank-sim/account with a transaction table showing columns Id, Date, Description, Amount, Balance, and Actions, with the Checking tab active by default

steps.action: Verify the Checking tab is active and transaction rows are displayed including the account-opening entry
steps.expected: The Checking tab shows at least the 'Account Opening' row with $250.00 amount and a running balance, plus subsequent debit transactions

steps.action: Click the Saving tab to switch to the savings account view
steps.expected: The Saving tab becomes active and the transaction table updates to show savings account rows including a Network ATM withdrawal and the account-opening entry; the pagination reads '1 - 2 of 2'

workflows.scenario: Search transactions on the Account Activity page
preconditions: The Account Activity page is loaded at /bank-sim/account with the Checking tab active

steps.action: Navigate to ACCOUNTS > ACCOUNT ACTIVITY via the nav menu
steps.expected: The Account Activity page is displayed with the Checking transaction table showing multiple rows

steps.action: Type a transaction description keyword (for example 'Streamwave') into the Search textbox
steps.expected: The transaction table filters live to show only rows whose description contains 'Streamwave'; non-matching rows are hidden
The full unfiltered transaction list is restored in the table

workflows.scenario: View the Monthly Statement page and observe the empty state before any statement period has elapsed
preconditions: The simulator calendar date is in the first month; no complete calendar month has yet passed

steps.action: Open the ACCOUNTS nav menu and click MONTHLY STATEMENT
steps.expected: The Monthly Statement page loads at /bank-sim/account/monthly with Checking and Saving account tabs visible and a Search textbox

steps.action: Observe the content area of the Monthly Statement page
steps.expected: A heading reads 'No statements have been generated yet! Feel free to check back next month.' confirming the empty-state behavior when no statement period has closed

workflows.scenario: Open the Make a Transfer form and verify Save button is disabled with empty required fields

steps.action: Open the TRANSFERS nav menu and click MAKE A TRANSFER
steps.expected: The Transfer Money form page loads at /bank-sim/transfer with required fields PAYMENT FREQUENCY, Transfer From, Transfer To, Amount, and Payment Date visible

steps.action: Observe the PAYMENT FREQUENCY, Transfer From, and Transfer To comboboxes without selecting any value
steps.expected: All three comboboxes are empty and no transfer account is selected
The Save button is disabled, preventing submission when required fields are unfilled
No transfer is created; the user remains on or is navigated away from the transfer form without any mutation to account data

workflows.scenario: Open the Pay a Bill form and verify SUBMIT button is disabled when required fields are empty

steps.action: Open the BILLS nav menu and click PAY BILL
steps.expected: The Pay a Bill form page loads at /bank-sim/pay-bill with Pay From pre-filled as CHECKING (showing available balance), and empty fields for Payment Frequency, Recipient, Payment Date, and Amount

steps.action: Observe the Recipient combobox and Payment Frequency combobox without selecting any value
steps.expected: Both the Recipient and Payment Frequency comboboxes are displayed but unselected
The SUBMIT button is disabled, preventing bill payment submission until all required fields are populated
